problem_statement_title: Rural Entrepreneurship: From Local Opportunity to the Next Evidence-Based Decision
objective: Help rural women entrepreneurs evaluate a business idea using available evidence and make one practical next decision.
core_problem: Rural women may have useful skills, local resources and business ideas but often lack reliable information about customer demand, pricing, profitability, markets, logistics, risks and business support.
success_outcome: The entrepreneur understands what to test, what it will cost, who may buy, what evidence is missing and what she should do next.
